response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS n FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, n AS project_count, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / AVG(n * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM per

assumptions.assumption: Missing funding source means NULL fundflux only; NULLs form one group via GROUP BY. Empty strings, if any, stay a separate group.
The average per funding source is the unweighted mean of project counts across the funding-source groups, including the NULL group.
